Built from the public OpenRouter API (no key, no test requests), reading every model's endpoints listing every 15 minutes, keeping a snapshot when something changed and one full snapshot a day; changes are also published as an RSS feed. For live prices, latency and each provider's full price history, use the model's page on OpenRouter. Prices are USD per million tokens as the listing quotes them, after any provider discount. Wayback Machine copy marks points transcribed by hand from Wayback Machine copies of the model page.

An independent record; not affiliated with OpenRouter.
